decisions.proposed_text: Tăng giới hạn Stamina, Guts và Wit,\nSpark giúp giảm giá Skill 「Celeste Oath」
decisions.reason: Current phrase 'giúp nhận giảm giá cho Skill' is awkward; preserve the locked Skill title while normalizing inheritance wording.
decisions.terminology_basis: Locked Celeste Oath; canonical Stamina, Guts, Wit, Skill and Spark terms preserved.
